title: The Asmodian Princesses and the Witch in the Forest
description:
STORYParallel world × 3D dungeon exploration
One day, Mikaze Shoichi heard the call from a mysterious goddess.
"Please come and take down the devil!"
Although it sounds like a template, Shoichi still came to the "demon world".
"Demon world" is a dangerous world inhabited by asmodians.
After meeting the two princesses of the asmodian royal family and the king, Shoichi was made to make an "ultimate choice", and the legend of this young man began.FEATURES• JRPG

• 3D Dungeon Crawl 

• Visual Novel
